page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is a storage-focused instance built on an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. Built on a KVM hypervisor platform, this instance delivers 24 dedicated virtual CPUs alongside 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 4.0 GB of memory per dedicated core.

The defining characteristic of this server configuration is its high-density bundled local storage, offering 70,866 GB of local hard disk drive (HDD) capacity. Network connectivity is supported by an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, facilitating sustained data transport between cluster nodes and local drives.

Because local storage is backed by traditional HDD technology rather than NVMe SSDs, the instance prioritizes bulk capacity density over random I/O performance. This profile provides high cost efficiency for large-scale sequential data storage and processing tasks where capacity per node is critical. Appropriate workloads include Big Data analytics frameworks like Hadoop or Spark clusters, distributed log accumulation, cold data archiving, sequential file processing, and ETL pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is a dedicated x86_64 virtual server provisioned on a KVM hypervisor, tailored for storage-dense workloads. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 CPU operating at 2.5 GHz across 24 dedicated vCPUs, backed by 96.0 GB of RAM to maintain a balanced 1:4 memory ratio. A key component of its architecture is the inclusion of 70,866 GB of local HDD storage paired with an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The reliance on HDD media delivers substantial bulk capacity density at an economical resource profile, trading random I/O speeds for cost-effective mass storage. This server type is suited for big data processing, log analytics, data warehousing, file storage repositories, and large-scale ETL jobs requiring high local storage density.
